children: Bally's entered into a loan and security agreement for up to $560 million in senior secured term loans to support its planned Bally's Bronx project and general corporate purposes. The facility includes $400 million available at closing and a $160 million delayed draw, subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions. When funded, the loans will mature 18 months after initial funding and bear interest at Term SOFR (with floor) plus 8.50%, secured by substantially all assets of the loan parties. The agreement includes customary covenants, mandatory prepayment triggers, and a prepayment fee for full payoff.
: Senior secured term loan facility (Closing $400M + $160M delayed draw)
: WhiteHawk Capital Partners, as agent, and participating lenders
: Fund Bally's Bronx pre-construction and bolster liquidity
